needs: Production-OS verified autonomous Jumpy code-change qualification 34. Fix ONE real interface bug in scripts/main.gd: when the READY screen's Settings panel is open (settings_open == true), tapping empty space currently starts a game via _unhandled_input. Prevent that accidental tap-to-start while the settings panel is open. Keep the BACK button working, preserve all settings toggles and allow normal tap-to-start from the main READY menu. Leave the PLAYING and DEAD input branches, all physics, scoring, daily seed, Profile data, and UI layout unchanged. Implement the minimal guarded condition in existing Godot 4.7 GDScript; do not generate a marker, canary text file or documentation-only change. Do not change tests, dependencies, workflows, secrets or monetization. Use actual Godot 4.7.2 headless parse validation and persist the modified source in a review branch/pull request after verification. Never merge or publish Jumpy; report failure truthfully if model capacity is insufficient.

acceptance_criteria: When settings panel is open (settings_open == true), tapping any area outside the panel must not trigger _unhandled_input to start a new game.
The BACK button (or settings button toggle) must close the settings panel without starting a game.
All settings toggles (sound, haptics, reduced_motion, high_contrast) must remain functional and persist via Profile.
Normal tap-to-start from the READY menu (when settings_open == false) must start the game as before.
No changes to PLAYING or DEAD input branches, physics, scoring, daily seed, Profile data, or UI layout.
blockers: Lack of explicit back button node; may need to rely on settings button toggle.
Need to verify that UI nodes have appropriate mouse_filter to avoid event leakage.
scope: Modify _unhandled_input in scripts/main.gd to early‑return when settings_open == true and the input event is not handled by UI nodes.
Preserve existing BACK button behavior (assumed to be settings button toggle).
Keep all other input handling unchanged.
